program.major: Public Health with Concentration in Medicine Sciences
program.department: Herbert Wertheim School of Public Health

notes: Verified against catalog. Heaviest lower-division load (68-69 units): chemistry, physics, calculus, natural sciences. Upper-division 48 units. FIXED: elective block corrected from 16 to 12 units (USP 143 is inside the 12-unit block, not additional); replaced over-broad 'BIBC/BICD/BIMM/BIPN/PSYC 100-199' ranges with the catalog's enumerated approved list.

buckets.label: Natural science courses
buckets.note: 12 units (3 courses) from listed natural science courses; PHYS courses paired with their labs (1A/1AL, 1B/1BL, 1C/1CL)

buckets.label: Calculus + statistics
buckets.note: MATH 10A or 20A; MATH 10B or 20B; plus one statistics course (MATH 11, PSYC 60, COGS 14B, or HDS 60); 12-13 units

buckets.label: Public health core (Core Disciplines)
buckets.note: PH 101, PH 102, PH 110, PH 120, PH 130 (R variants substitute); 20 units

buckets.label: Medicine sciences course + elective (Public Health Perspectives)
buckets.note: PH 161 (or 161R) plus a selection from PH 140-191, PH 195P, PH 198, PH 199; 8 units

buckets.label: Health services course + designated electives
buckets.note: USP 143 required plus additional units from the enumerated approved list; 12 units total

buckets.label: Capstone / practicum
buckets.note: PH 193/193R + PH 194/194R (8 units), OR PH 196AH + PH 196BH (12 units)
